name: Ashtavargam Kashayam

sections.reference_sahasra_yoga_kashaya_prakarana: Ashtavargam Kashayam is a very famous Ayurvedic medicine in liquid form. It is used for the treatment of rheumatic diseases. Anti-inflammatory and analgesic actions of this medicine are quite good in reducing the inflammation, stiffness and swelling. It is used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, frozen shoulder, ankylosing spondylitis, paralytic disorders etc.
sections.ingredients:
Bala – Sida rotusa / Sida cordifolia 
 Sahachara – Strobilanthes ciliatus 
 Eranda – Ricinus communis 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Rasna – Pluchea lanceolata 
 Devadaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Nirgundi – Vitex negundo 
 Garlic – Allium sativum 

 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part to make the ashtavargam kashayam.
sections.dosage:
Take 12 – 24 ml, before food, at about 6 am and 6pm or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually advised to add equal amount of water to the kashayam (decoction).
sections.indications:
Joint diseases

 Arthritis

 Ankylosing spondylitis

 Backache 
 General body pains 
 Gout (along with Giloy preparations)

sections.side_effects:
There are no known side effects of using this medicine. 
 High dosage of this medicine may cause gastritis. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Ashtavargam Kashayam 
 Reference: Sahasra Yoga Kashaya prakarana 15 – 17 
 Ashtavargam Kashayam is a very famous Ayurvedic medicine in liquid form. It is used for the treatment of rheumatic diseases. Anti-inflammatory and analgesic actions of this medicine are quite good in reducing the inflammation, stiffness and swelling. It is used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, frozen shoulder, ankylosing spondylitis, paralytic disorders etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Bala – Sida rotusa / Sida cordifolia 
 Sahachara – Strobilanthes ciliatus 
 Eranda – Ricinus communis 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Rasna – Pluchea lanceolata 
 Devadaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Nirgundi – Vitex negundo 
 Garlic – Allium sativum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part to make the ashtavargam kashayam. 
 Dosage 
 Take 12 – 24 ml, before food, at about 6 am and 6pm or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually advised to add equal amount of water to the kashayam (decoction). 
 Indications 
 
 Joint diseases 
 Bloating 
 Arthritis 
 Osteoarthritis 
 Pain in muscles 
 Rheumatism 
 Joint Stiffness 
 Ankylosing spondylitis 
 Muscle Pains 
 Backache 
 General body pains 
 Gout (along with Giloy preparations) 
 Facial Palsy 
 Paralysis 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects of using this medicine. 
 High dosage of this medicine may cause gastritis. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
